name: insert the circumcentre of each bad triangle until all meet the quality bound
mechanism: while any triangle has an angle below the bound, insert its circumcentre as a new vertex and re-triangulate locally; if the new point would land too close to an input segment, split that segment at its midpoint instead; termination follows because inserted points are never closer than the local feature size allows

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Ruppert's algorithm (also known as Delaunay refinement)' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry: create quality Delaunay triangulations
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Chew's second algorithm': create quality constrained Delaunay triangulations

requires: an input with no very small angles between segments
fails_when: small input angles can prevent termination
instances: Ruppert's algorithm (also known as Delaunay refinement)
